# Test fixtures

Synthetic little-endian **arm64** Mach-O images generated by
`kh_loader::fixture` (not produced by Apple tooling). Execute fixtures have
`__PAGEZERO`, `__TEXT`/`__text`, `LC_UUID`, decorative
`LC_LOAD_DYLIB` (`/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib`), and `LC_MAIN`.

| File | Program |
|------|---------|
| `minimal_arm64_execute.macho` | `write(1,"kh\\n",3); exit(0)` |
| `errno_unknown_then_exit.macho` | unknown syscall (`x16=0xBEEF`) then `exit(0)` |
| `mmap_touch_exit.macho` | anon `mmap` + store + `munmap` + `exit(0)` |
| `memory_file_roundtrip.macho` | open → fstat64 → file `mmap`/`mprotect`/`msync` → `clock_gettime` → `sysctlbyname` → exit(0) |
| `roundtrip_payload.bin` | payload for the roundtrip fixture (`KAKEMAP01\\n`) |
| `libkh_add.dylib` | `MH_DYLIB` export `_kh_add` (`add w0,w0,w1; ret`), base `0x200000000` |
| `call_dylib.macho` | load `@executable_path/libkh_add.dylib`, classic bind + GOT-call `_kh_add(20,22)`, `exit(42)` |
| `call_dylib_chained.macho` | same as `call_dylib`, but `LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS` / `PTR_64` bind |
| `libkh_ctor.dylib` | `MH_DYLIB` with `__DATA,__mod_init_func` → writes `ctor\\n` then `ret` |
| `ctor_main.macho` | load ctor dylib; main only `exit(0)` (proves init before main) |
| `call_libsystem.macho` | load absolute `/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib`, classic bind + GOT-call `_kh_bottle_mark`, `exit(77)` |
| `bottle/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib` | synthetic bottle: `_write` / `__exit` (BSD `svc`), `_puts` / `_printf` (host helpers), `_kh_bottle_mark` → `77` |

See also `tests/clang-probe/` for real Apple-clang guests (`write_exit`,
`return_zero`, `puts_hello`, `printf_hello`) against the bottle.

Multi-image / bottle notes:

- Absolute `/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib` is **never** opened without `--root`
  (decorative loads → `skipped:no_bottle`).
- With `--root tests/fixtures/bottle`, `call_libsystem.macho` maps the synthetic
  stub and binds `_kh_bottle_mark` (live exit **77** on Linux aarch64).
- Without a bottle, `call_libsystem.macho` dry-load/bind fails with
  `UnresolvedSymbol` after soft-skipping libSystem.
- Linked fixtures: `call_dylib.macho` uses `LC_DYLD_INFO_ONLY` classic bind;
  `call_dylib_chained.macho` uses `LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS`. nlist → `__got`
  remains a fallback when neither is present.
- `call_dylib.macho` and `libkh_add.dylib` must be **siblings** on disk
  (`@executable_path` resolves against the main executable directory).
- Text `kh run --dry-load` output lists per-image status; **JSON** is the
  stable scripting surface (`images[]` array).

Regenerate:

```bash
cargo run -p kh-loader --example write_fixture            # all
cargo run -p kh-loader --example write_fixture -- errno   # one
cargo run -p kh-loader --example write_fixture -- roundtrip
cargo run -p kh-loader --example write_fixture -- dylib   # libkh_add + call_dylib
cargo run -p kh-loader --example write_fixture -- ctor    # libkh_ctor + ctor_main
cargo run -p kh-loader --example write_fixture -- libsystem  # bottle + call_libsystem
```

Live run of `memory_file_roundtrip.macho` needs CWD such that
`tests/fixtures/roundtrip_payload.bin` resolves (repo root / Docker `/app`).
The shared mapping mutates the first payload byte to `X`; restore the file
before re-running if you need a clean pass.
